summary: NL Industries, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its reincorporation merger from New Jersey to Delaware, effective May 26, 2026. The merger was executed via an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated May 19, 2026, under which Predecessor Corporation merged into NLI Holdings, Inc., the surviving entity. Each share of Predecessor common stock automatically converted into one share of successor common stock with identical par value. The reincorporation was approved by shareholders on May 14, 2026. This filing also establishes NLI Holdings as the successor issuer under Rule 12g-3. No terms are applicable as this is a domicile change, not an acquisition or restructuring. Watch for normal NYSE listing continuation under the new name.
